caption:
Needy men don't see the real problem. It's childhood wounds running their brain. Mindset shift for men serious about dating and self improvement.

Every need for reassurance, every panic when she goes silent, every message you regret sending. That's not you. That's a ghost from your childhood.

Your father was absent or cold. Your mother was inconsistent. You learned that performing earned love. Now you perform in every relationship.

The wound isn't your fault. The way you respond to it is. Name the pattern. Trace it back. Own it. Then change it.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
